title: Germany’s Merz admits ‘disaster’ in state elections, vows to press ahead with reforms
summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz on Sunday described his CDU party's heavy losses in two regional elections as a "disaster", but vowed to push ahead with a reform drive.
